title: Online Order Data Flow
scenario: A Customer submits an Order Request to the "1.0 Process Order" process. The process writes order records to the "D1 Orders" data store and sends a Confirmation back to the Customer.
goal: Connect Customer -> 1.0 Process Order, 1.0 Process Order -> D1 Orders, and 1.0 Process Order -> Customer using Data Flow edges.
learningObjective: Trace how data moves between External Entities, Processes, and Data Stores in a Level-1 DFD.
hints: Data flows are directional: drag from the sender to the receiver.
External entities (Customer) communicate with processes (1.0 Process Order), not directly with data stores.
Include the return flow from 1.0 Process Order back to Customer.
solutionExplanation: Customer sends the request to 1.0 Process Order, which persists the order in D1 Orders and returns a confirmation to Customer.
